stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: replacement interactive home-town background map for an existing Japanese children's fantasy RPG. Image 1 is the old home map, a functional layout reference. Image 2 is the newly redrawn title landscape, a color, pixel-art finish and world-style reference. Create a completely fresh town illustration in the same inviting bright classic 16-bit JRPG atmosphere as image 2, using a readable elevated three-quarter, near-top-down view like image 1. Wide 16:9 opaque landscape canvas, entire canvas filled. This is a close-up playable hub town, not the distant panoramic title landscape. Rich spring greens, warm cream stone, blue and orange tiled timber-framed roofs, crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, clear flat-shaded forms and carefully crafted detail. A coherent walkable town with broad warm cobblestone paths connecting distinct facilities around a central circular fountain plaza, a modest stream and small stone footbridge, gardens, trees and a forest-and-mountain backdrop across the top. The fountain plaza at x50% y48% contains a small charming magical orb monument, suggesting the existing gacha activity without any casino imagery, money, slot machines or text. Preserve this functional approximate composition for clickable overlay labels added later: archery training yard with targets in upper-left around x15% y14%; blue-roofed alchemy/crystal workshop around x35% y33%; cozy private home around x30% y51%; recognizable herbal/potion shop around x30% y66%; weapon forge with anvil, swords and a warm chimney glow around x71% y56%; adventurers' guild with an outdoor wooden noticeboard around x83% y33%; a welcoming stone arena or raid gate with deep red banners around x76% y16%; an inviting forest path opening around x50% y15%; the main adventure road leading out near x58% y78% and continuing toward the bottom. Leave the lower-left 20% of the image mostly quiet grass, low flowers and stone edging so the player's status overlay can sit there. Keep all important buildings inside the frame with comfortable margins. Buildings should have genuinely new silhouettes and architecture, not a trace or collage of the old image. Each facility has a distinctive recognizable visual cue, but NO drawn labels, letters, numbers, sign text, UI, buttons, logos, map pins, arrows or borders anywhere. No added characters, giant castle, dark night, isometric diamond-shaped floating island, horror, spiders, photographic rendering, smooth vector style, blur or checkerboard. The result should feel like a beautiful lively, peaceful adventure village that belongs to the newly redrawn title world. Output one polished game-ready map image only.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: game-ready home-town background map for a Japanese children's classic JRPG. Image 1 is the edit target, the newly drawn town. Preserve its complete composition, perspective, building positions, recognizable facilities, roads, fountain, water, greenery, lighting and cheerful palette. CHANGE ONLY the rendering to noticeably coarser pixel art, following the user's request for a slightly larger pixel grain. The current image is too finely detailed. Redraw it as if natively made on a roughly 480x270 logical pixel canvas, then displayed at a larger size with hard nearest-neighbor pixel edges: visible 3–5 output-pixel square clusters, clearly stepped contours, crisp dark pixel outlines, simplified readable roof tiles and windows, larger leaf/grass/stone clusters and only 3–4 flat shades per material. Use a restrained coherent environment palette of roughly 64–80 colors. Eliminate tiny one-pixel noise, micro-textured wood grain, fine individual grass blades, overly intricate masonry, painterly shading, smooth gradients, antialiasing and blurred edges. Do not simply blur the image or apply a mosaic filter; redraw the scenery with intentional chunky pixel clusters and the clarity of a handcrafted 16-bit RPG town map. Preserve charming architectural silhouettes and distinct function cues: fenced archery yard upper-left; blue crystal alchemy workshop upper-left-middle; red-bannered stone raid arena upper-right; guild and noticeboard right; central blue-orb fountain; blue-roofed private cottage left-middle; green-roofed potion shop lower-left-middle; forge with chimney and anvil right-middle; forest path top-center; exit road and stone bridge bottom-center. Wide 16:9 opaque full-canvas scene. Keep the lower-left grass area quiet for the player status overlay. No UI, text, lettering, logo, drawn labels, characters, floating map pins, frame, checkerboard or added objects. Same scene, same atmosphere, clearly coarser pixels.
